title: Convert Residual Files
bottom_line: A one-off move: each old `.planning/residual/*.md` file becomes a GitHub issue labeled `ai`, then the file is deleted.

sections.heading: Use it once to move old residual files into GitHub issues

before.label: Old format
before.text: Leftover work sits in files named `.planning/residual/<N>_*.md` inside the repository.

after.label: New format
after.text: Each item is a GitHub issue labeled `ai`, the format `/plan-tools:write-issue` and `/plan-tools:impl-issue` use.

blocks.caption: This is a one-off migration for repositories that used the older file-based residual format.

blocks.title: The same `ai` label is shared across the plugin
rows: Deferred work goes into GitHub issues labeled `ai`

sections.heading: Run it with no arguments, or name a different label

blocks.caption: With no arguments the label is `ai`.

blocks.title: What you can pass
rows: Uses `<name>` wherever the command would use `ai` as a label: the label check, the label creation and the label on each issue. Without it, the label is `ai`.

cards.title: git installed
cards.text: The plugin needs `git` alongside the GitHub CLI.

cards.title: GitHub CLI signed in
cards.text: Install `gh` and sign in with `gh auth login`, with push access to the repository. Every issue, PR and status command goes through `gh`.

sections.heading: Each file becomes one issue, oldest first, then it is deleted

steps.title: Finds the old files
steps.text: It lists `.planning/residual/*.md`. If there are none, it tells you and stops.

steps.title: Makes sure the label exists
steps.text: If the `ai` label (or your `--label` name) is missing, it creates it, with the description "Queued for autonomous implementation".

steps.title: Reads each file, oldest first
steps.text: It works through the files in order of their number `<N>`, starting with the oldest, and reads each one in full.

steps.title: Writes a title
steps.text: It takes the title from the file name or the file's first line.

after.label: Issue title
after.text: Fix null check in auth middleware

steps.title: Opens the issue
steps.text: The file's full contents become the issue body, with the label attached.

steps.title: Deletes the file
steps.text: A file is deleted only once its issue was created successfully.

sections.heading: You get a count, the issue links and an empty folder

items.label: per residual file
items.note: each listed with its URL in the report

blocks.title: The final report tells you
items: How many issues were created, with their URLs.
That `.planning/residual/` is now empty. If it is empty, the folder itself is removed.

next_action.text: Run `/plan-tools:convert-residual` in a repository that still has files under `.planning/residual/`.
next_action.detail: If there are no such files, the command tells you so and stops.
